flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: App.tsx:313, utils/models/Icsdbatch.d.ts (unused type). ocmsadminprivateapi: utilities/sftpComponent/SftpConfig.java (server list without State Courts). No court application submit controller/service in the six repos.
note: 1-point story (status_with_ura: Fully paid): a Confirm button on the review screen so OCMS sends the batch of notices to State Courts. There is no button, endpoint or job to submit a court application batch. SFTP configuration only knows the servers azureblob, ces, mha, toppan, icms, repccs, lta, cftvhub (SftpConfig.java:204-211), with no State Courts server. The only batch hint is the TypeScript type Icsdbatch.d.ts, which is not used anywhere. Real SFTP/State Courts: cannot verify from repo. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The Court Application feature (submission to State Courts) is not in the six repos; only comments, TypeScript types and menu placeholders remain. Ask URA/the team in which repo it was built, or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: The review screen offers a Confirm button to submit the court application
steps.detail: There is no Court Application page or route in ocmsadminui: App.tsx only has an empty comment {/* COURT */} (App.tsx:313) and no batch review/submit route. Searching 3+ synonyms (court application, court batch, csd batch, charge sheet, case registration) across ocmsadminui, ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi and thirdpartyapi found no controller, service or page that submits to State Courts.

steps.step: Confirm triggers processing of the selected batch
steps.detail: There is no endpoint to submit/confirm a court application batch in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi. api-authorization only lists generic CRUD /v1/courtcase, /v1/summon, /v1/courtmention and /v1/courttrial (api-authorization.properties:23), not a batch confirm action.

steps.step: OCMS sends the batch of notices to State Courts
steps.detail: The SFTP server list is only azureblob, ces, mha, toppan, icms, repccs, lta, cftvhub (SftpConfig.java:204-211); there is no State Courts server or folder in sftp-common.properties. No code sends a batch to the courts. Real SFTP connectivity: cannot verify from repo.
